mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, provider, provider_subject AS providerSubject, union_id AS unionId FROM user_identities WHERE provider = #{provider} AND provider_subject = #{providerSubject} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_identities (id, user_id, provider, provider_subject, union_id) VALUES (#{identity.id}, #{identity.userId}, #{identity.provider}, #{identity.providerSubject}, #{identity.unionId})
